package rulefixtures

import (
	"html/template"
	"net/http"
	"os"
)

// scenario for file_or_template_read_per_request: Request-path handlers that read files directly instead of using startup caching or dedicated file-serving paths.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: gin; severity: contextual.

func RenderPage(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	tmpl, _ := template.ParseFiles("templates/layout.html", "templates/page.html")
	tmpl.Execute(w, map[string]string{"Title": "Welcome"})
}

func ServeConfig(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	data, _ := os.ReadFile("config/settings.json")
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.Write(data)
}
